lines.text: 真实还是虚幻，乔治。你分不清的。／分不清，可我们也得装作分得清那样过下去。／阿门。
lines.en: Martha: Truth and illusion, George. You don't know the difference. / George: No, but we must carry on as though we did. / Martha: Amen.
lines.evidence: https://www.filmsite.org/whos3.html（逐字："Martha: Truth and illusion, George. You don't know the difference." "George: No, but we must carry on as though we did." "Martha: Amen."）；https://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/w/whos-afraid-of-virginia-woolf-script.html（逐字："Truth or illusion, George? Doesn't it matter to you at all?" / "Truth and illusion. You don't know the difference." / "No, but we must carry on as though we did."）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；乔治另有变体"Truth and illusion. Who knows the difference eh, toots?"（filmsite 逐字）

lines.text: 我是大地之母，你们全是窝囊废。
lines.en: I am the Earth Mother and you are all flops.
lines.evidence: https://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/w/whos-afraid-of-virginia-woolf-script.html（逐字："I am the Earth Mother and you are all flops."）；https://whifferdills.tumblr.com（逐字："I am the Earth Mother, and you are all flops. Elizabeth Taylor as Martha in Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966)"）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译。用户提示的"I am the earth, and the earth is me"未能在任何逐字来源核到，银幕实际台词为此句

lines.text: 谁害怕弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫？／我，乔治。我怕。
lines.en: Who's afraid of Virginia Woolf? / I am, George. I am.
lines.evidence: https://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/w/whos-afraid-of-virginia-woolf-script.html（逐字："Who's afraid of Virginia Woolf? / I am, George. I am."）；https://www.filmsite.org/whos3.html（逐字："Martha: I am George, I am."）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；两源标点略有出入

lines.text: 你有没有在波基普西挑过脚？
lines.en: Did you ever pick your feet in Poughkeepsie?
lines.evidence: https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/The_French_Connection_(film)（逐字："Popeye Doyle: Did you ever pick your feet in Poughkeepsie?"）；https://eriklundegaard.com/item/movie-review-the-french-connection-1971/category/62（影评逐字引用该时刻）；https://www.reddit.com/r/iwatchedanoldmovie/comments/1qr64pf/the_french_connection_1971/（中译"你在波基普西挖脚趾头吗？"）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（审讯行话，通行字幕译法未核到）；IMDb 专设片段页 The French Connection: Poughkeepsie, NY（tt0232508）

lines.text: 我要把他送上电椅，烤焦他的屁股。
lines.en: I'm gonna fry his ass in the electric chair.
lines.evidence: https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/The_French_Connection_(film)（逐字："Popeye Doyle: I'm gonna fry his ass in the electric chair."）；IMDb quotes 页（tt0067111/quotes）多次抓取超时未获第二逐字摘录

lines.text: 我来这里是要接我儿子回家的。可我发现，他已经在家里了。
lines.en: I came here to take my son home. And I realized he already is home.
lines.evidence: https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Kramer_vs._Kramer（逐字："And I realized he already is home. Oh, I love him very much... I'm not gonna take him with me. Can I go up and talk to him?"）；https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0079417/quotes/（逐字："I came here to take my son home. And I realized he already is home."）；https://www.reddit.com/r/movies/comments/291m3h/what_are_the_best_most_memorable_monologues_by/（中文版逐字："我来这里是为了带我的儿子回家。然后我意识到，他已经在家里了。"）
lines.note: 中文采用 Reddit 中文讨论版译法，标注为对照译法

lines.text: 医生：你没理由进去。／泰德：有理由。他是我儿子。你们要对他做什么，我都要陪着他。
lines.en: Doctor: There's no reason for you to be in there. / Ted: Yeah, there is. He's my son. If you're gonna do something to him, I'm going to be with him.
lines.evidence: https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/kramer-vs-kramer/family-quotes.html（逐字："DOCTOR: There's no reason for you to be in there. TED: Yeah, there is. He's my son. If you're gonna do something to him, I'm going to be with him."）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（比利脑伤医院场景）

lines.text: 我要妈妈！／你现在只有我了。
lines.en: Billy: I want my mommy! / Ted: I'm all you got.
lines.character: 比利·克莱默 / 特德·克莱默
lines.evidence: https://www.funtrivia.com（Great Movie Exchanges 测验逐字："I want my mommy!" "I'm all you got."，答案 Kramer vs. Kramer）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（乔安娜离家当晚父子场景）

lines.text: 要不要来点小小的恋尸癖？嗯？
lines.en: Care for a little necrophilia? Hmmm?
lines.evidence: http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（Notable Quotes 逐字："Jill: Care for a little necrophilia?. . .Hmmm?"）；https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0088846/quotes/（收录该台词）；clip.cafe 专段标题"Care for a little necrophilia - Brazil"

lines.text: 这是你丈夫的收据……这是你的收据的收据。
lines.en: This is your receipt for your husband... and this is my receipt for your receipt.
lines.evidence: http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（逐字："Arresting Officer: This is your receipt for your husband...and this is my receipt for your receipt."）；https://www.dailyscript.com/scripts/brazil.html（剧本逐字："OFFICIAL: That's your receipt for your husband." "OFFICIAL: Thank you. And this is my receipt for your receipt."）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；剧本措辞与成片字幕略异

lines.text: 听着，小子，我们都在一条船上。
lines.en: Listen, kid, we're all in it together.
lines.evidence: http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（Notable Quotes 逐字："Tuttle: Listen, kid, we're all in it together."；同页另录海报标语"Billboard: Happiness: We're all in it together."）
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；同源另核到海报句"幸福：我们都在其中"

lines.text: 你是踏着手下的肩膊升级的，你有没有替你的手下着想？死了一个手下，你只是写份报告书，鞠三个躬。我们这些小卒也是有妈妈生的，没有我们这帮小卒替你卖命，你哪有这么大间冷气房坐啊？
lines.original: 同左（粤语原音逐字未能核到，此为通行中文字幕两版拼合转写）
lines.evidence: https://bbs.nga.cn/read.php?tid=42718780（逐字："你是踏着手下的肩膊升级的，你有没有替你的手下着想？死了一个手下，你只是写份报告书，鞠三个躬…"）；https://view.inews.qq.com/k/20210506A0BYWF00（逐字："我们这些小卒也是有妈妈生的，没有我们这帮小卒替你卖命，你哪有这么大间冷气房坐啊？"，https://kknews.cc/zh-cn/entertainment/lgnzo9g.html 同文）
lines.note: 两源为不同字幕版本，措辞略有出入，已按出处分别保留；粤语原声逐字需对香港原版字幕进一步核对

lines.text: 法律？法律只能制裁没钱请律师的人！不能制裁他！
lines.original: 同左（通行中文字幕转写）
lines.evidence: https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/135974701（逐字："‘法律会制裁他的’，陈警官的回答是：法律？法律只能制裁没钱请律师的人！不能制裁他！"，语境为朱滔法庭脱罪后）；百度知道“港台法庭经典台词”及 kknews 2019-09-14《為什麼說〈警察故事〉是最偉大的成龍電影》均逐字收录该句并标注出处《警察故事》
lines.note: 粤语原音逐字未能核到，标注为通行中字转写
